items.source: Get the current value of the version property for an instance of a relational persistent entity.
items.translation: 获取关系持久实体实例的 version 属性的当前值。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the entity does not have a version property.
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果实体没有版本属性。

items.source: Utilities commonly used to set/get properties for instances of RelationalPersistentEntities.
items.translation: 用于设置和获取关系持久实体实例属性的常用工具。

items.source: Set the version property on an instance of a relational persistent entity.
items.translation: 为关系持久化实体实例设置 version 属性。

items.source:
Set the version property on an instance of a relational persistent entity. This method returns an instance of the
same type with the updated version property and will correctly handle the case where the version is immutable.
items.translation: 在关系持久化实体实例上设置 version 属性。此方法返回一个相同类型的实例，其 version 属性已更新，并能正确处理 version 不可变的情况。

items.source: version - The value to be set on the version property.
items.translation: version - 要设置在 version 属性上的值。

items.source: Current value of the version property
An instance of the entity with an updated version property.
items.translation: 具有已更新版本属性的实体实例。
